name: Health, Behavior, and Society
notes: Six courses. Fulfils the social sciences academic division of the Rochester Curriculum.
Students may major, minor, OR complete a cluster within the public health-related programs, but not more than one.
No more than ONE course may overlap between a public health minor and another program of study - stricter than the College's usual two-course cap, so overlapCapOverride is set to 1.

Several electives carry validity windows or class-year restrictions noted on the page (MHB 220 valid until fall 2023; MHB 420U from spring 2025; PHLT 216 until spring 2022; the MHB 4xxU courses are open to juniors and seniors).

requirementGroups.label: Required courses
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Required Courses: PHLT 101: Introduction to Public Health I; PHLT 116: Introduction to the U.S. Health System

requirementGroups.label: Electives (4)
requirementGroups.sourceQuote: Plus four of the following: ANTH 216: Medical Anthropology; GSWS 206/PHLT 206: The Global Politics of Gender and Health; HIST 359W; HIST 373W; HIST 383W; MHB 220; MHB 420U; PHLT 216; PHLT 236: Healthcare and Law or PHLT 230: Public Health Law and Policy; PHLT 240: Communities Mental Health and Injury Prevention; PHLT 265W: Global Health; PSYC 283: Behavioral Medicine; MHB 473U OR MHB 480U
